caseName: Federal Power Commission v. Southern California Edison Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Power Commission v. Southern California Edison Co. and City of Colton v. Southern California Edison Co.
attorneys: Austin L. Roberts, Jr. on the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 372 U. S. 958, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The motion of the National Association of Railroad & Utilities Commissioners for leave to join in the brief of the Public Utilities Commission of California, as amicus curiae, is granted.
